The Story: Zero-Dependency Distribution

The dist/ directory hosts the bundled and minified releases of Engine 2 (The Conveyor Belt). These files are published to GitHub Pages and npm, allowing developers to import the 1D transformer directly into vanilla browser modules without any bundler or build steps.

Mounting min.js automatically registers the engine onto the global namespace under window.ks.transformer.funcs.oneDimension and exports standard ES module functions. 

<!-- CDN Production Import -->
<script type="module" src="https://keshavsoft.github.io/json-transformer-funcs-one-dimension/dist/v9/min.js"></script>
